title: Pinecones & Acorns
description: Forest foraging: jams, resin, Forest Forager villager, throwable weapons, and Forest Wreath. By tototara Studio.
body:
# Changelog — Pinecones & Acorns [1.0.1]

**Release Date:** 2026-06-12

Welcome to **Pinecones & Acorns**, a cozy forest-themed expansion that adds new resources, food, villagers, and progression to your Minecraft world.

## New Features

### Forest Harvesting

* Pine cones now drop from **spruce leaves**
* Acorns now drop from **oak** and **dark oak leaves**
* Cherries now drop from **cherry leaves**

### Throwable Forest Items

Turn nature into a weapon:

* **Pine Cone** — deals 2.5 hearts of damage
* **Acorn** — deals 3 hearts of damage and briefly stuns targets

### Jars & Jam Making

* Added **Empty Jar**
* Added **Water Jar**
* Added the **Jam Table**

Craft three unique jams, each providing a powerful buff:

* **Thornberry Jam** — grants Thorns
* **Oakberry Jam** — grants Resistance II
* **Cherry Jam** — grants Regeneration II

### Forest Harmony

Consume all three jams within 5 minutes to activate **Forest Harmony**, causing most hostile forest creatures to remain peaceful for a limited time.

### Forest Wreath

Wear the **Forest Wreath** to blend into the woods:

* Zombies ignore you
* Creepers ignore you

### Pine Resin System

Harvest resin directly from spruce logs:

* 30% chance to obtain **Pine Resin** when using an axe

New resin-based items:

* **Resin Ball** — deals 1 heart of damage and applies Slowness I
* **Resin Torch** — light level 12

Also included:

* New **Sticky Piston** recipe using Pine Resin

### Forest Forager Villager

Meet the new **Forest Forager**, a villager specializing in woodland goods.

Includes:

* 5 trade tiers
* Exclusive forest-themed trades
* Master-level rewards:

  * **Golden Acorn**
  * **Golden Pine Cone**

## Advancements & Compatibility

* Custom advancements
* English and Russian localization
* Optional JEI support

## Supported Languages

* English
* Русский
* Deutsch
* Français
* Español
* Português (BR)
* Italiano
* Polski
* Українська
* 日本語
* 中文 (简体)
* 中文 (繁體)
* 한국어
* Nederlands
